title: Laboratorio: Optimización de Uniones con Broadcast Join
goal: Verificar la velocidad de un Broadcast Join frente a una unión estándar cargando una dimensión de catálogo en memoria.
code:
import duckdb

con = duckdb.connect()
# Tabla de transacciones grande
con.execute('CREATE TABLE fact_tx AS SELECT range AS id, (range % 10) AS cat_id, (range * 2.5) AS monto FROM range(200000);')
# Tabla de dimensión pequeña
con.execute('CREATE TABLE dim_cat AS SELECT range AS cat_id, "Categoria_" || range AS nombre FROM range(10);')

# Consulta unida emulando broadcast join en memoria
res = con.execute('''
    SELECT 
        d.nombre,
        COUNT(f.id) AS total_operaciones,
        ROUND(SUM(f.monto), 2) AS total_monto
    FROM fact_tx f
    JOIN dim_cat d ON f.cat_id = d.cat_id
    GROUP BY d.nombre
    ORDER BY d.nombre
    LIMIT 3;
''').fetchall()

for r in res:
    print(f'{r[0]}: {r[1]} ops, Total={r[2]}')
